content.rendered:
Professional Wood Products Manufacturer

Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd. was founded 26 years ago and is located in Shouguang City, Shandong Province, China. As a reliable wood products manufacturer, we specialize in producing MDF, plywood, particle board, WPC wall panels, furniture, doors, grates, and various decorative materials.

Our factory features modern production workshops:

Wood Processing Workshop – producing high-quality MDF, plywood, and particle board.
Furniture & Panel Workshop – manufacturing durable furniture, WPC wall panels, doors, and grates.

With a dedicated team of skilled workers and quality control experts, we strictly follow international quality standards to ensure every product meets customer expectations.

Our products are exported worldwide, serving customers in the United States, Europe, Australia, and many other regions. We focus on “green environmental protection” and sustainable manufacturing, combining craftsmanship with innovative solutions.

Why Choose Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry?

  • Over 26 years of experience in the wood products industry

  • Advanced production workshops and professional quality control system

  • Sustainable and eco-friendly materials with strict manufacturing standards

  • Global export with reliable logistics and packaging solutions

  • Customizable solutions for furniture, doors, and decorative projects

  • Dedicated technical support and professional service

Products We Supply:

  • MDF – high-quality, smooth, and versatile boards

  • Plywood – durable and stable for construction and furniture

  • Particle Board – cost-effective and strong

  • WPC Wall Panels – eco-friendly and decorative

  • Furniture – functional and stylish designs

  • Doors & Grates – safe, durable, and customizable

  • Decorative Materials – complete solutions for interiors

As a professional wood products manufacturer, we provide standard products as well as OEM/ODM services to meet specific project requirements.

Contact Us
Looking for a reliable wood products manufacturer? Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd. is ready to provide high-quality products, competitive prices, and professional support.

📩 Get in Touch Today – Let’s Build a Long-Term Partnership!

👉 For more details about our product range  the latest updates on Facebook , please explore further.

Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd. | About Us – MDF, Plywood, Particle Board, WPC Panels, Furniture & Decorative Materials Manufacturer
Professional Wood Products Manufacturer

Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd., founded 26 years ago in Shouguang City, Shandong Province, China, is a professional wood products manufacturer specializing in MDF, plywood, particle board, WPC wall panels, furniture, doors, grates, and decorative materials.

Our company is committed to green environmental protection and sustainable manufacturing. With advanced production workshops and strict quality control, we ensure every product meets international standards and customer expectations.

Our Factories and Workshops

  • Wood Processing Workshop – producing high-quality MDF, plywood, and particle board.

  • Furniture & Panel Workshop – manufacturing durable furniture, WPC wall panels, doors, and grates.

Why Choose Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry?

  • Over 26 years of experience as a trusted wood products manufacturer

content.rendered:
Professional Wood Products Manufacturer

Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd. was founded 26 years ago and is located in Shouguang City, Shandong Province, China. As a reliable wood products manufacturer, we specialize in producing MDF, plywood, particle board, WPC wall panels, furniture, doors, grates, and various decorative materials.

Our factory features modern production workshops:

Wood Processing Workshop – producing high-quality MDF, plywood, and particle board.
Furniture & Panel Workshop – manufacturing durable furniture, WPC wall panels, doors, and grates.

With a dedicated team of skilled workers and quality control experts, we strictly follow international quality standards to ensure every product meets customer expectations.

Our products are exported worldwide, serving customers in the United States, Europe, Australia, and many other regions. We focus on “green environmental protection” and sustainable manufacturing, combining craftsmanship with innovative solutions.

Why Choose Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry?

  • Over 26 years of experience in the wood products industry

  • Advanced production workshops and professional quality control system

  • Sustainable and eco-friendly materials with strict manufacturing standards

  • Global export with reliable logistics and packaging solutions

  • Customizable solutions for furniture, doors, and decorative projects

  • Dedicated technical support and professional service

Products We Supply:

  • MDF – high-quality, smooth, and versatile boards

  • Plywood – durable and stable for construction and furniture

  • Particle Board – cost-effective and strong

  • WPC Wall Panels – eco-friendly and decorative

  • Furniture – functional and stylish designs

  • Doors & Grates – safe, durable, and customizable

  • Decorative Materials – complete solutions for interiors

As a professional wood products manufacturer, we provide standard products as well as OEM/ODM services to meet specific project requirements.

Contact Us
Looking for a reliable wood products manufacturer? Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry Co., Ltd. is ready to provide high-quality products, competitive prices, and professional support.
